summary:
Forgotten Footprints is an interactive storytelling website that explores NASA's discarded equipment on the Moon and Mars. The platform allows users to discover forgotten space equipment through an interactive map, visual galleries, and mission timelines. Users can learn about each object's original purpose, its location, and the mission it was part of.

Our project addresses the challenge by transforming scientific and historical information into an engaging digital experience, giving forgotten equipment the attention it deserves.

It is important because it preserves the history of space exploration, raises awareness of past NASA missions, and inspires students, educators, and space enthusiasts to explore the stories behind humanity's journey beyond Earth.
details:
Our project is an interactive storytelling website designed to explore NASA's discarded equipment on the Moon and Mars.

The platform allows users to discover abandoned equipment through an interactive map, explore equipment profiles, and learn about the missions behind each object. Each profile provides information about the equipment's name, original purpose, location, and historical significance.

The project aims to make space exploration history more accessible and engaging for students, educators, researchers, and space enthusiasts. It helps preserve the stories behind these objects and highlights their contribution to scientific discovery.

What makes our project creative is its storytelling approach. Instead of presenting equipment as simple technical objects, we connect each one to its mission and the history of space exploration through an interactive visual experience.

During development, our team considers user experience, accessibility, information accuracy, visual design, and the reliability of NASA data.

The planned technologies include HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for web development, along with mapping and visualization tools where needed. NASA resources will be used as references for the information presented.
